messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Sorry for the oversight  

Hi [Colleague’s Name],

I wanted to apologize for [briefly describe what happened—e.g., missing the deadline on the report / sending the wrong file]. I understand it caused inconvenience, and I take full responsibility. I’ve already [corrective action—e.g., resent the correct document / adjusted my schedule to meet the new deadline] and will ensure it doesn’t happen again.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
